reviews.author: Carl Hochreiter
reviews.text: Found this shop after searching on FB for an honest place to get my ac looked at. Did a great job at a reasonable price. Decided to come back the next day with an issue with anther vehicle. Another garage told me I needed new struts bc of the squeaking I was hearing in the back.....turns out to be a loose spoiler!!! Much cheaper!!!! Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Kayla Butler
reviews.text: My daughter’s car got towed to Inman SC and that’s how I found this repair shop. I went off everyone else’s reviews to decide to let him work on her car and, I tell you I’m so glad I did. I may live 45 minutes away but he will forever be my person I go to for any car needs. Not only is he so friendly but he sends pictures and updates throughout the process and works with you. I would definitely recommend him to anyone. Such a nice friendly trustworthy guy!

reviews.author: Nazar Khudoba
reviews.text: I bring my fleet vehicles here for repairs and the service has always been great. They don’t overcharge like many other shops. Everything was honest, fair, and the pricing made sense with no crazy markups. It’s hard to find a shop you can trust, but these guys do a really good job.

reviews.author: Darlene Shinavier
reviews.text: Paul helped a damsel in distress at the end of the workday as I was on a road trip between FL and TN when my car all of a sudden started making a loud noise. I was afraid to keep driving so I got off on the next exit and searched for the nearest mechanic which was AC&C. Paul got me fixed and back on the road in about 45 minutes at a very fair cost! I even paid him more than he charged I was so impressed. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Makayla Magagnotti
reviews.text: The only business I trust with my Volvo! They are extremely nice, honest, and accommodating. I know my car is in good hands when I need repairs. Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Scott Gantter
reviews.text: Paul is an amazing mechanic and he truly cares for his customers. The work he did on my 2015 Ram was done fast and with the highest quality I have ever experienced. The price for his service was by far more than reasonable. I highly recommend AC&C for any auto repair you won’t find anyone better . Thanks again Paul

reviews.author: Ed's Auto Glass
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with AC&C Auto Repair in Inman, SC. They’re extremely professional, honest, and knowledgeable, exactly what you want from a trusted local mechanic. If you need engine diagnostics, transmission repair, brake repair, or routine maintenance, I highly recommend this place. It’s hard to find a reliable auto repair shop, but AC&C definitely sets the standard for quality service and fair pricing.

reviews.author: Iryna Reshnyuk
reviews.text: Paul will not only take care of your car issues with great professionalism for a really good price. But Paul is a really good hearted person that genuinely cares for his customers. Really recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: Katelyn Gordon
reviews.text: Has been FABULOUS everytime I've needed work done on my Mini Cooper. Just an overall amazing guy who does amazing work. Highly recommend to anyone needing a knowledgeable and HONEST mechanic that doesn't charge an arm and a leg.

reviews.author: Reno Rolle
reviews.text: We traveled 3.5 hours to have an inverter repaired that was installed by an up-fitter in California to power our onboard refrigerator. The unit stopped working and was causing problems with our lighting and other issues. Pavel was incredibly accommodating and made himself available at our convenience. He dropped everything the moment we arrived and immediately got to work in the pouring rain. This was a fairly complicated electrical issue that required the passenger seat to be removed and then some tricky maneuvering in a very tight space. Pavel was able to diagnose and fix the problem very quickly. He was kind and very professional. Thank you pavel for a great job well done!

reviews.author: Daniel Krinitsyn
reviews.text: Pavel was amazing! I brought in my Jetta and he was able to quickly diagnose and properly repair it. Gave me a great price. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sawyer Smith
reviews.text: Genuine and honest mechanic, gave a fair price compared to most other garages. Recommend using for your car troubles.

reviews.author: Eduard Radion
reviews.text: Great mechanic shop. If you need automotive repair, give them a call, and they will get you taken care of!

reviews.author: Vlad
reviews.text: Excellent mechanic, did a full diagnostic, identified the problem, and fixed it quickly. So if your car is acting up, he's definitely the one to go to! 10 out of 10!
